verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that wake agents on a five-field schedule and deliver a prompt on every fire. Agents can also set their own recurring schedules, which the platform syncs into real wake triggers. The platform explicitly positions itself as a home for cron jobs, scheduled functions and background workers, so this is a recurring autonomous schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs fire reliably, and documented failure/retry handling and monitoring for unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A cron trigger takes a standard five-field expression, wakes the agent on schedule, and delivers its `prompt` as a chat message on every fire.
tell it "send me a digest every weekday at 9" and the platform syncs the schedule it sets for itself into real wake triggers.
Move the automation layer of your cloud onto Maritime agents: cron jobs, scheduled functions, background workers, and bots.
